name: com.x402toolshop/tools
title: x402 Tool Shop
description: Pay-per-call x402 tools: wallet risk, sanctions, x402 checks, weather, email, DNS, company data.

tools.name: clinical_calculator
tools.description: Clinical calculator: standard medical formulas in one call: bmi, bsa, egfr, crcl, cha2ds2_vasc, has_bled, map, corrected_calcium, anion_gap, qtc, ldl_friedewald. Pick one with calc=, pass its inputs (kg/lb and cm/in accepted); returns the result, unit, interpretation band and the formula's published reference. Inputs are range-checked; errors are never charged. Price: $0.004 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="clinical_calculator".

calc.description: One of: bmi, bsa, egfr, crcl, cha2ds2_vasc, has_bled, map, corrected_calcium, anion_gap, qtc, ldl_friedewald

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Company profile for a domain: the company name and description from its own homepage, social profiles (X, LinkedIn, GitHub and more), public contact emails, domain age and expiry and registrar (RDAP), hosting network and country, mail provider with SPF and DMARC, technology hints (Shopify, WordPress, Next.js...), and whether the domain is on a crypto phishing list. Useful for vendor checks and lead enrichment. Public sources only. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="company_profile".

tools.name: csv_preflight
tools.description: CSV preflight: validate a CSV before import and find every load error first. Detects the delimiter, line endings, BOM and encoding damage, header problems (blank or duplicate names), rows with the wrong field count (with line numbers), unterminated quotes, duplicate rows, and per-column type, empty rate and mixed or ambiguous values. Returns ready true/false plus every issue. POST JSON {csv}, up to 1.5 MB. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="csv_preflight".

has_header.description: Optional: whether row 1 is a header (detected if omitted)

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: DNS lookup for any domain: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA and SOA records in one call, plus the domain's email DNS (SPF and DMARC policy) read out plainly. Or ask for one record type. Resolved live through three public resolvers with automatic fallback. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="dns_lookup".

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com (a URL is accepted; the host is used)

type.description: Optional single record type: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, CAA, SOA

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Email validation and verification before sending: is this address likely deliverable? Checks syntax, the domain's mail servers (MX), SPF and DMARC, role addresses (info@, sales@) and disposable email providers, and returns a verdict with reasons. Never contacts the mailbox. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="email_check".

tools.name: event_weather
tools.description: Weather for a game, stadium or concert: will weather affect this event? Hourly rain chance, wind, temperature and active alerts for the hours of a US sports or concert event, with roof type (dome, retractable, open) so indoor events say so. Name the venue, team or coordinates and the start time (up to ~6 days out). Source: NOAA National Weather Service. Track record (last 30 days, 1015 graded): temperature within 3°F on 72% of events, peak wind within 5 mph on 75%; rain-chance Brier score 0.07 (0 is perfect, 0.25 is a coin flip). Full record: https://api.x402toolshop.com/track-record/event-weather Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="event_weather".

venue.description: Venue name, venue id, or home team (e.g. 'Lambeau Field', 'Green Bay Packers')

event.description: Instead of venue+start: an event from our schedule, e.g. 'Packers at Lions'

lat.description: Latitude for any other outdoor US location (use with lon)

start.description: Start time, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is read as local time at the venue.

in_hours.description: Instead of start: the event starts this many hours from now (0-150)

tools.name: page_watch
tools.description: Web page change monitoring: did this page change since you last looked? Fetches a public page, compares it with the previous snapshot (ours, or the snapshot_id from your earlier answer), and returns the text that appeared and disappeared, price changes (before / after) and stock wording (in stock, sold out). The first call for a URL saves the baseline. For product pages, price tracking, availability, policy and docs changes. Static HTML only (pages that render everything in JavaScript show little text). Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="page_watch".

url.description: The public page to check (http or https)

snapshot_id.description: Optional: compare against this snapshot from an earlier answer instead of the latest one

tools.name: sanctions_screen
tools.description: OFAC sanctions screening for a company or person name (fuzzy, aliases included) and/or a crypto wallet address, e.g. a counterparty or payTo wallet before paying it. Checked against the US Treasury OFAC SDN list (names plus 1,000+ listed wallets), refreshed daily. Returns match / possible_match / no_match with the listed entries and programs. Refuses rather than answers if the list is stale. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="sanctions_screen".

name.description: Person or company name to screen

address.description: Crypto wallet address to screen (any chain OFAC lists)

type.description: Optional: only match this SDN type (individual, entity, vessel, aircraft)

tools.name: wallet_risk
tools.description: Wallet risk check before you pay: is this wallet (and the site asking you to pay or sign) known to be sanctioned, a scammer or phishing? Screens the address against the US Treasury OFAC SDN wallet list (refreshed daily) and ScamSniffer's scam address list, the domain against ScamSniffer's 360k+ crypto phishing domains, and reads live on-chain basics (contract or wallet, transactions sent, balance) on Base, Ethereum, Polygon or Arbitrum. Returns high_risk / caution / no_known_risk with reasons. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="wallet_risk".

address.description: Wallet address to check (EVM 0x..., or a Solana address for the list checks)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, polygon or arbitrum: for the on-chain basics

domain.description: Optional: the site or URL asking you to pay or sign, checked against the phishing list

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: Weather forecast by city: current weather, hour by hour, and the 7-day forecast for any US city ('Goshen, IN'), ZIP code or coordinates, plus active weather alerts. Source: NOAA National Weather Service, cached briefly so answers come back fast. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="weather_forecast".

tools.name: x402_check
tools.description: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it. Makes one unpaid call, reads the 402 payment terms (v1 body or v2 header) and validates every option: the token is the official USDC contract for its network (not a look-alike), the price parses, the terms point back at the URL you called. Screens the payTo wallet (OFAC sanctions, scam list, on-chain basics), checks the site against 360k+ crypto phishing domains and its domain age, and reads the endpoint's public record on nohumans.directory (verified, delivered when bought). Returns do_not_pay / caution / no_problems_found with reasons, plus the cheapest option. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="x402_check".

url.description: The x402 endpoint you are about to pay, with its parameters

method.description: GET (default) or POST: how you will call it

max_price.description: Optional: your budget per call in USD; a higher price is flagged

tools.name: free_sample
tools.description: Free: a real answer from any tool for its example input, so you can see the output before paying. tool is one of: clinical_calculator, company_profile, csv_preflight, dns_lookup, email_check, event_weather, page_watch, sanctions_screen, wallet_risk, weather_forecast, x402_check.
